title: Origin story: Durga
description: Durga was created from the combined wrath and radiance of all the gods when the buffalo-demon Mahisha drove them from heaven. Each god gave her a weapon; riding her lion, she battled Mahisha for nine nights, slaying him as he shifted through elephant, lion, and man forms.

title: Ability profile: Durga
description: Ranked abilities: Combat mastery — rank 100/100; Multi-weapon skill — rank 99/100; Maternal ferocity — rank 98/100; Endurance — rank 97/100; Radiance — rank 95/100.

title: Power ranking: Durga
description: Powers: Eighteen arms bearing the gods' combined weapons; The lion mount, swifter than thought; Invincibility born of united divinity.

title: Stamina feats: Durga
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Fought Mahisha for nine days and nights; Returns in every age evil threatens.

title: Crossover notes: Durga
description: Durga crosses naturally with: protection, righteous war, motherhood, evil's destruction.

title: Cultural impact: Durga
description: Navaratri honors her nine nights; the divine feminine as warrior.
